notes: Catalog title is "Civil Works Bid-Out", but the 14-page PDF combines three forms: FDP Form 10a Civil Works (pp. 1-2, 15 projects), FDP Form 10b Goods and Services (pp. 3-13, 62 items) and FDP Form 10c Consulting Services (p. 14). Transcribed as tables civilWorks, goodsServices and consulting.
Page 2 continues the CIVIL WORKS BID-OUT table (rows 8-15) but its header line reads "FDP Form 10b - Bid Results on Goods and Services"; treated as civil works per the table title and columns.

Civil works "Name and Address" column prints a contact person followed by the address; the person is in bidderContact and the address in bidderAddress. Row 5 (Warsky Ventures Inc.) prints only an address.

Civil works row 14 bidder cell prints "TEN TWENTY ALLIED DEVELOPERS / WORLDWIDE" (text cut off at the cell edge); row 15 prints "TEN TWENTY ALLIED DEVELOPERS / WORLDWIDE BUILDERS (JV)". Transcribed as printed.

Goods and services "Name and Address Of Bidder" column repeats the bidder name (in bold) above the address; only the address is kept in bidderAddress. Where the repeated name differs from the Winning Bidder cell: "NEEDINK SALES AND SERVICES" vs "NEED INK SALES & SERVICES"; "TOYOTA, LAPU-LAPU CEBU" vs "TOYOTA LAPU-LAPU, CEBU"; "5J'S METAL CRAFT & GENERAL MERCHANDISE CO. LTD." vs "5J'S METAL CRAFT AND GENERAL MERCHANDISE CO. LTD."; "PILLCORP" vs "PILLCORP."; "SONCEHL PHARMA DISTRIBUTORS" vs "SONCHEL PHARMA DISTRIBUTORS"; "ACE MEDICAL SOLUTIONS INC." vs "ACE MEDICAL SOLUTIONS, INC."; "GREENFIBR CORP." vs "GREENFIBR CORPORATION"; "ALOG AND COMPANY INC." vs "ALOG AND COMPANY, INC."; "NISSAN CEBU DISTRIBUTORS INC." vs "NISSAN CEBU DISTRIBUTORS, INC.".
Consulting Services form (FDP Form 10c) prints "NONE" in every column: no consulting services were bid out in Q4 2024.
Goods and services form has no No., Location or Contract Duration columns.

bidderNormalized: a canonical spelling added by the transcriber so the same company ranks as one bidder across documents (case, punctuation and obvious misspellings unified, e.g. variants confirmed by the bidder name repeated in the address column or by an identical contact person/address). The printed name is kept unchanged in bidder.
